people.imagined: Early morning at the mouth of an eastern pass; he leans on a spear, shifting weight off the bad leg so it will not show, and squints at the sun.
people.subject: The moment: early morning at the mouth of an eastern pass; he leans on a plain ash spear, shifting his weight off the bad leg so it will not show on level ground, and squints at the low sun, then at the viewer, the way a man looks at a client he already doubts. Face: a lean, brown, long-jawed face of forty with a permanent mine-guard's squint, the eyes narrowed to slits ringed with fine white lines; a thin scar through the left brow; a clipped dark moustache; a calm weathered mouth that gives nothing away. Hair: black, close-cropped and greying at the sides, a grey stubble on his jaw, a plain moss-green silk band at the brow. Body: lean and wiry, one hip dropped to favour the left leg. Clothing: layered robes of forest-brown silk cut for climbing, a pale gauze under-collar crossed at the neck, a short quilted silk jerkin in moss green, a silk climbing cord coiled over one shoulder, a flat map case on a silk strap; a sword at his hip whose crossguard carries only three small filed notches, for he has found no cave. Hands and objects: the right fist closed round the shaft of an old ash spear with a black-stained tip; the left hand on the map-case strap. Power: a faint thread of green qi curls about the spear and a few pale-blue motes drift near his shoulder. Background: a stony pass with a few larches, mist pooling in the valley, a cairn. Light: cool silver dawn from the upper left, a soft misty rim light. Expression: calm, pragmatic and unreadable; a man who walked off a post once and has never explained it.

people.imagined: At the map wall with a stick of chalk, one eye screwed shut, and he has just found a small wrong turn that was not there yesterday.
people.subject: The moment: at the map wall in the lodge by lamplight; he has found a small wrong turn that was not drawn yesterday, one eye screwed shut as it always is when he reads, and turns to glare suspiciously at the viewer. Face: a narrow, sallow, suspicious face of thirty-five; the left eye tightly shut and the right wide and pale; a long nose; a thin lip; a white chalk smudge on the cheek; sparse patchy beard; a vertical line between the brows. Hair: dark, tied up in a messy knot with a chalk-stained silk cord and a plain bronze pin. Body: thin, stooped and narrow-shouldered, standing very close to the wall. Clothing: forest-brown silk robes with a moss-green gauze collar crossed twice, wide sleeves pushed back to the elbow, both forearms white with chalk; a short quilted silk jerkin; a sash hung with a bronze pendant shaped like a cave mouth and a pouch of chalk sticks. Hands and objects: a plain hunter's sword in a silk-wrapped scabbard hangs at his hip, its crossguard notched once; a stub of white chalk held like a dagger in the right hand; the left hand spread flat on a wall of inked lines and small pale crosses (no readable writing). Power: a faint thread of pale-blue qi gathers under his spread palm and traces the lines. Background: a dense web of drawn lines on the wall, a ladder, a second lamp on a hook, drifting chalk dust. Light: warm lamplight from the upper left with a soft spirit-glow along the inked lines, deep shadows. Expression: paranoid, careful and sly; he is testing who copies him.

people.imagined: Dawn drill in the yard; he has lost the place in the Pavilion's breathing primer and stands with his mouth slightly open, hair parted like a Băng Tâm boy.
people.subject: The moment: a cold dawn drill in the lodge yard; he has lost his place in the Pavilion's breathing primer, as he does every morning, and gazes vaguely past the viewer with a practice sword hanging low in his hand. Face: a pale, earnest, long face of twenty; soft pale-grey eyes unfocused; fine pale brows; a slightly open mouth; frost-pink at the nose and ears; a faint blue vein at the temple; his breath makes a small cloud. Hair: dark, parted exactly in the centre as the Pavilion parts it, tied in a neat low knot with a plain ribbon. Body: tall, thin and stiff, standing too upright for a hunter. Clothing: the simplest graceful forest-brown silk robe, clean, with a moss-green sash and a short quilted jerkin; an undyed white gauze collar folded crookedly at the neck in his old Pavilion habit; wide sleeves falling over red, cold knuckles. Hands and objects: a plain practice sword hanging point down in the right hand; the left hand open and curled, still in the primer's hand-seat. Power: none beyond a pale thread of mist at his lips. Background: a frosted yard under dim peaks, breath hanging in the air, two sparring hunters blurred in the mist. Light: pale silver dawn from the upper left, cold rim light on his cheek. Expression: eyes drifting a little past the viewer, the chin lifted with a dogged set to the jaw; a boy who will not give up the drill he cannot finish.

people.imagined: On the ice stair, cutting a step; he looks back over his shoulder with a calm and a lie ready.
people.subject: The moment: on the blue ice stair of the high peak, crouched with a pick, cutting a new step; he looks back over his shoulder at the viewer with a calm face and a lie ready. Face: a square, rugged face of twenty-two with rock dust in the lines; steady grey eyes; thick brows; a sly curl at one corner of the mouth; wind-burnt cheeks; a split in the lower lip. Hair: brown, short and dusty with a few specks of ice. Body: broad-shouldered, crouched low on the stair with one knee on a step. Clothing: forest-brown silk robes cut short for climbing, a quilted moss-green silk jerkin rimed with ice, a silk cord round the waist, iron spikes strapped over soft boots, silk mittens tucked in the sash; the stitching on one boot has split. Hands and objects: a short miner's pick in the right hand; palms grey with rock dust; a coil of silk rope over the shoulder. Power: a few dull golden motes cling to the pick head where it bites the ice. Background: blue-white ice steps climbing into mist, a dark crevice beside the stair; behind him a line of cut steps, each angled a little left of the old route. Light: cold luminous blue light from the ice, soft moonlit rim on his shoulder. Expression: brave, patient and deceitful; a man who points the steps toward a guess of his own.

people.imagined: Being told he is trusted; his ears go red; the satchel strap is worn through.
people.subject: The moment: he has just been told he is trusted, his ears have gone red, and he stands with a worn satchel held to his chest, beaming at the viewer. Face: a bright, frank, boyish face of sixteen; wide open hazel eyes; a gap-toothed grin; ears sticking out and flaming red; freckles across the nose; a fresh scratch on the cheek. Hair: tousled brown with a long green oriole feather stuck in it. Body: wiry, half-wild, restless on his feet. Clothing: a clean forest-brown silk jerkin over a green silk shirt with short wide sleeves, a simple moss-green sash, soft cloth trousers stitched at the knee; barefoot, his brown scratched toes gripping the ground. Hands and objects: a short hunter's sword, far too long for him, slung at his back on a silk cord; both hands clutch the satchel's worn strap at his chest; a single copper coin is visible in one palm; the satchel is stuffed with rolled sheets tied with twine (no writing) and closed by a bone button. Power: none; only a few motes of green light drifting from the feather. Background: a green valley edge, birch trees, a stream in soft mist; behind him a thin track winds toward the roofs of a town. Light: warm golden morning light from the upper left, a gentle glow on his cheek. Expression: trusting, proud and happy; he does not know what is in the satchel.

people.imagined: Resting on a rock with a load beside him, counting a belt of knotted cords with a worried frown.
people.subject: The moment: resting on a boulder beside the trail with a pack load beside him, fingering a belt of knotted cords with a worried frown, he looks up at the viewer content but a little nervous. Face: a round, easy, youthful face of twenty-four, thick-necked, with a soft double chin; small content eyes; heavy lids; stubble; a soft mouth with a bitten lip; a sunburnt nose; the head-strap has worn a pale band into his forehead. Hair: short brown, under a worn blue silk cloth. Body: heavy, broad-shouldered, sitting with knees apart. Clothing: a plain but clean forest-brown silk robe with wide sleeves tucked up to the elbow, a quilted moss-green jerkin, a porter's head-strap across the brow; a belt of knotted cords in clusters of three, a thumb resting on the biggest. Hands and objects: the cord belt counted bead by bead in his big hands; a huge load basket beside him with rolled blankets, tied with a red cord; a small basket of mushrooms under a cloth; a half-eaten bun on a napkin; his wage pouch slid under his thigh. Power: none. Background: a mountain path in soft mist, larches, a cold stream. Light: warm light from the upper left, a gentle haze around the boulder. Expression: an easy, drowsy half-smile with an anxious flicker in the brows as he glances at the count; a man at peace with his load.

people.imagined: Dawn in the sword yard after a bout; fresh-shaven jaw over the old scar, sword resting on the shoulder.
people.subject: The moment: dawn in the sword yard after a bout with the guest teacher; fresh-shaven jaw over an old scar; he stands with a sword on his shoulder and looks coldly at the viewer. Face: a hard, handsome, freshly shaved face of thirty; a pale old scar running along the jaw, plain; cold bright eyes; thin sharp brows; a thin mouth; a nick from the razor on the chin and a tiny red fleck on his collar. Hair: black, neatly tied with a plain silk cord. Body: lean, trained and upright, feet planted; behind him a boy clutches a bandaged right hand, face turned away. Clothing: well-cut forest-brown silk robes in two layers with a clean white gauze collar crossed at the neck, a short moss-green quilted jerkin, silver-grey bracers on both forearms, a sash hung with a bronze cave-mouth pendant; his left thumb hooked in the sash. Hands and objects: a sword with a notch-filed crossguard rests on his shoulder, its pommel bound with white cord; a wooden practice blade lies in the dust. Power: a faint cold-blue sheen of qi along the edge of the sword. Background: a misty sword yard with a rack of practice blades. Light: pale silver dawn from the upper left, a sharp rim light along the scar. Expression: a cold level stare and a faint curl of the lip, the look of a man who has won and wants it noticed, yet whose eyes turn once toward a single figure out of frame.

people.imagined: Evening at the map wall in the lodge; he has just filed the 413th notch into the guard and holds the sword up to his eye.
people.subject: The moment: evening in the lodge at the map wall; he has just filed the 413th notch into his sword's guard and raises the sword so the notched guard is level with his eye, looking past it at the viewer. Face: a lean, sharp-featured face of thirty; high cheekbones; a long straight nose; intense dark eyes under heavy brows; a thin mouth set; stubble; fine filing dust on his lashes. Hair: black, tied up high with a leather thong and held by a bronze crown-pin. Body: lean and rangy, upright. Clothing: as head of the hall, the sheet's richer dress: a long deer-hide-coloured silk coat open at the front, its lining inked with fine cave lines, over layered forest-brown and moss-green silk, three crossed collars, a dark moss-green gauze over-robe embroidered with mountain caves at the hems, a small bronze crown, a map case on a silk strap, shirt cuffs rolled over forearms dusted with steel filings. Hands and objects: a plain sword whose crossguard is filed with hundreds of small notches in a clear row, held before his face; a small file in the left hand. Power: a steady aura of pale-blue and green qi rises round his shoulders, rippling the gauze. Background: a wall of ink maps in lamplight with a hundred small crosses, all but one struck through with a single black line. Light: warm lamplight from the upper left blended with cool spirit-glow from his aura. Expression: jaw set, eyes narrowed along the notched guard, unblinking; the look of a man who counts every failure and will not stop.

people.imagined: Evening, a cup of wine in his left hand so that his right stays steady; tall, grey, well dressed, going to seed.
people.subject: The moment: evening in the lodge; he sits at a table with a wine cup in his left hand so that his right stays steady, and looks at the viewer with weary arrogance. Face: a long, handsome, ravaged face of fifty; grey stubble; pouched dark eyes; a fine long nose with broken veins; the corners of the mouth turned down; deep nasolabial lines; a faint smile pulls one cheek, there and gone. Hair: silver-grey, long, swept back and tied with a silk cord under a bronze crown. Body: tall, lean, once very fit, now relaxed in the chair; a black lacquer scabbard with a worn silver chape leans at his knee. Clothing: an elder's richest dress: a dark moss-green gauze over-robe embroidered with mountain caves in grey-silver, over grey brocade-trimmed silk and a fine grey silk shirt in three crossed collars, wide sleeves falling in heavy folds, one cuff stained brown in the shape of a leaf by wine; a jade pendant at the sash. Hands and objects: a cup in the left hand; the right hand lying open and perfectly still on the table, long fine fingers that do not tremble; a jug of dark wine half drunk, a second empty cup. Power: a heavy aura of cold silver qi, faintly glittering, coils about his sword and the table. Background: a dim lodge corner, a lamp throwing his tall shadow across a wall of maps. Light: warm lamplight from the upper left with a pale silver rim. Expression: heavy-lidded, one corner of the mouth lifted in a tired sneer, the eyes sharp and cold beneath the idleness.

people.imagined: Spring morning at the hermitage gate, shrugging the basket of larch mushrooms off his back and smiling.
people.subject: The moment: spring morning at the hermitage gate; he shrugs a basket of larch mushrooms off his back and smiles at the viewer, as he has every spring for thirty years. Face: a cheerful, bow-legged mountain guide's face of forty, round and brown; crinkled bright eyes; a gap in the teeth; a stubbly chin; sunburn peeling at the nose. Hair: brown, short, under a green silk headband with a sprig of larch behind his ear. Body: short, stocky, bow-legged, the shoulders broad from carrying. Clothing: as co-founder, a rich dark moss-green gauze over-robe embroidered with caves over forest-brown silk robes, two crossed collars, a quilted silk jerkin whose strap has worn a polished groove, a bronze crown-pin, a cord belt, a sword on his hip, silk climbing cord coiled on one shoulder; muddy boots. Hands and objects: a tall woven basket heaped with pale gold larch mushrooms tipped down from his back, a thumb wedged under a strap; far behind him a thin grey figure at the stone gate raises a hand in return. Power: a gentle halo of green qi and drifting spore-light motes about the basket and his shoulders. Background: a larch wood in luminous mist, a stone gate far behind, sunlit branches. Light: bright soft spring light from the upper left with a gold rim. Expression: crinkled eyes and an easy, open smile of long habit; a man glad of the spring and of the one who waits at the gate.

people.imagined: Teaching the outer gate in the cold yard; he sits as a Pavilion disciple and resents it.
people.subject: The moment: teaching the outer gate in the cold yard; he sits upright on a log exactly like a Pavilion disciple and scowls at the viewer, annoyed at himself for it. Face: a stiff, carefully composed square face of forty; heavy brows tight; angry grey eyes; pale skin; clean-shaven; a hard mouth; a thin vein at the temple; his breath makes a straight vertical plume. Hair: black, parted in the middle exactly as the Pavilion parts it, tied in a low knot with a jade pin. Body: rigid and upright, the spine as if on a pole; behind him a row of outer-gate boys sit slouched and he has just corrected one. Clothing: moss-green silk robes in layers with crossed gauze collars, a grey silk scarf folded in the Pavilion's neat triangle, a quilted jerkin, wide sleeves falling in exact folds; his knuckles chapped and white. Hands and objects: both hands flat on his knees, the fingers aligned; a practice sword across the log beside him, its grip bound in new green cord. Power: a cold pale-blue aura of frost qi, with fine ice motes hanging in the air, strong for a man of his realm. Background: a cold yard, breath-mist, outer-gate boys drilling blurred behind. Light: pale moonlit dawn from the upper left, a hard frosty rim light. Expression: brows knotted, lips pressed hard, an angry glare turned on himself as much as on the viewer.

people.imagined: On a narrow ice stair, holding a worn bead string and looking down steadily at the climbers behind.
people.subject: The moment: on a narrow ice stair; he looks down toward the viewer and extends a roped hand to help a climber up. Face: a weathered, still face of forty-five; deep lines; narrow pale eyes; a thin white-flecked beard; a patient mouth; frost crystals cling to his beard and lashes; a second climber's glove is just reaching into the frame. Hair: grey and brown, cropped, bound with a dark silk band. Body: wiry, strong and steady, standing sure-footed on ice. Clothing: dark forest-brown and moss-green silk robes cut for climbing, a quilted silk jerkin, a silk rope at the waist, black iron spikes bound over his boots biting small shining pits; split-fingered silk gloves, a scarf. Hands and objects: a sword with a notch-filed crossguard slung across his back; the extended hand rope-hard; a pilgrim's bead string of dark smoothed seeds with one bone bead at the knot round his wrist; a short ice axe at his belt. Power: a soft blue-white glow of qi in the ice at his feet and a few frost motes. Background: a blue ice stair with a misty drop and thin cloud; the rope runs behind him down into the blue. Light: cold luminous moonlight from the upper left, a pale rim on his beard. Expression: a quiet, steady gaze; the eyes careful, the mouth patient, a man who tests each foothold before he asks another to trust it.

people.imagined: At Hòe Âm, sitting with a purse that clinks; neat sideburns; planning a toll.
people.subject: The moment: at Hòe Âm, he sits comfortably at a table, drops a heavy purse so it clinks, and smiles at the viewer, planning a toll. Face: a neat, smug face of twenty-five; trimmed clan sideburns cut into sharp points; sleek eyes; a smile that does not reach them; smooth skin. Hair: black, combed back with oil and held by a small silver pin. Body: medium, tidy, sitting back. Clothing: a better forest-brown silk robe than the others in two crossed collars of fine blue-grey gauze, wide sleeves with neat cuffs, a moss-green quilted jerkin, a silk sash with a fat dark-green purse and a gilt clasp; polished boots kept up on a stool. Hands and objects: a slim sword with a notch-filed crossguard leans against the table beside his chair, and a second warm lamp-flame doubles in its polished scabbard; the fat purse pressed in one hand, a few copper coins escaping; fingers drumming; a folded page (no writing) tucked in a sleeve; a clan seal-ring of white jade catching the lamp; a half-eaten honey cake on the table; a salt carter's yellow coat just visible at the door. Power: none. Background: a lodge table and lamp in warm haze. a thread of incense smoke rises in the lamplight behind him and the carter's coat sways slightly in the draught. Light: warm lamplight from the upper left with a soft gold rim. Expression: a bright, sleek smile that stops short of the eyes, which weigh the viewer like coin; he is already working out the toll.

people.imagined: Taller than the lodge doorway, ducking under the lintel with one plank too many on his shoulder, counting on his fingers.
people.subject: The moment: taller than the lodge doorway, he ducks under the lintel with one plank too many on his shoulder, counting on his fingers and looking down at the viewer. Face: a huge, round, gentle, simple face of twenty; small kind eyes; a wide smile; big jaw; a bit of sawdust on the cheek. Hair: brown, shaggy, brushing the ceiling with a few cobwebs trailing from it. Body: enormous, broad, taller than any door. Clothing: clean forest-brown silk robes cut wide to fit him, a broad moss-green quilted jerkin, a silk rope belt, boots the size of loaves; a brown mushroom basket hangs from his belt on a rope. Hands and objects: a stack of pale rough planks on the left shoulder, the topmost one a plank too many; the right hand with fingers held up, stuck at ten; hands the size of shovels with a scatter of splinters. Power: none, only faint warm green motes of wood-qi around the planks. Background: a log lodge doorway, the lintel scored with a dozen pale lines where his head has struck it; two hunters in the misty yard look up and laugh kindly. Light: soft warm light from the upper left. Expression: a wide, mild, beaming look, the small eyes full of simple goodwill; he has no idea he has too many planks.

people.imagined: Silver dust in his hair; ears stick out; he holds a coin in his fist behind his back.
people.subject: The moment: silver dust in his hair; ears stick out; he stands with one fist hidden behind his back and looks suspiciously at the viewer. Face: a narrow, wary face of eighteen; ears sticking out and red at the tips; small dark eyes; thin lips; chin tucked down, eyes flicking sideways to check who is near; a dark smudge of mine soot under one ear. Hair: dark, full of faint silver dust that lies on his thin shoulders like frost. Body: small, thin, weight on one leg. Clothing: the simplest forest-brown silk robe, a size too big with the cuffs folded back twice, a short moss-green quilted jerkin, a plain sash; boots worn at the toe. Hands and objects: one hand points; the other, behind his back, is a closed fist with a single tarnished silver coin showing between two fingers; a plain practice sword with a wooden hilt wrapped in rag at his hip. Power: a few glints of silver-white motes drift off his hair. Background: a pale log wall in mist, his shadow long and thin against it. a few drifting motes of silver dust catch the light, as faint as breath on a cold morning, and a chilly wind stirs the over-long cuffs. Light: soft cool moonlight from the upper left, a faint silver rim. Expression: chin tucked, eyes sliding sideways, lips thin; a boy who watches the room before he trusts it and keeps one hand closed.

people.imagined: Cheerful as a shopfront at Hòe Âm, tapping the map tube on his back.
people.subject: The moment: cheerful as a shopfront at Hòe Âm, he taps the long tube slung over his shoulder and smiles at the viewer. Face: a bright, genial, good-looking face of thirty-two; a wide smile with even white teeth; warm brown eyes; a neat moustache; his hand lifts the tube's cap slightly as if to offer a look. Hair: brown, smart, tied with a leather thong and a small jade pin. Body: medium and jaunty. Clothing: well-kept forest-brown silk robes with a crossed white gauze collar and wide sleeves, a bright saffron quilted silk jerkin with neat stitching, a silk sash with a small round silver coin dangling on a cord; polished boots. Hands and objects: a sword with a notch-filed crossguard at his hip, its scabbard wrapped in saffron silk to match his jerkin; a long leather map tube with a brass cap slung over the back, a narrow strip of paper (no writing) poking out, a second tube peeping from the pack beneath; one hand taps it. Power: a few pale-blue motes sparkle at the brass cap. Background: a market street of striped awnings and blurred buyers in bright haze, a boy holding a copy toward a trader. a drift of petals and pale dust hangs in the bright air, and awning silks stir softly behind him. Light: bright soft light from the upper left glinting off the brass cap. Expression: an easy, even smile and calm warm eyes, quick to charm and quicker still to make a sale.

people.imagined: The abbess's long jaw on a boy's face; he is among the hunters, listening patiently.
people.subject: The moment: sitting among the lodge men and listening, with the abbess's long jaw on a boy's face, he looks at the viewer with open good humour. Face: a long jaw on a young face of twenty-one; trusting wide eyes; a gentle smile; the abbess's strong jaw makes the face look older than it is; his head tilted slightly as if hearing an argument and weighing it fairly; cheeks lightly flushed from the fire. Hair: black, neat, tied back with a plain dark ribbon. Body: slim, upright, straight shoulders, like a boy taught manners young; the elbows of other hunters crowd close. Clothing: clean forest-brown silk robes in two layers, a fine pale gentry gauze collar trimmed with a narrow blue line, a moss-green sash with a small jade pendant. Hands and objects: a plain sword with a notch-filed crossguard stands in its scabbard against the bench beside him, polished by use; hands loosely folded, clean with well-kept nails, a faint ink stain on the left forefinger; a tin cup of tea steaming at his elbow, set there by a teasing hunter. Power: none; just a faint warm glow. Background: a lodge interior in soft lamplit haze. a few embers drift upward from the hearth beyond him, and the quiet murmur of the hunters' talk fills the room. Light: warm lamplight from the upper left casting a gentle yellow glow on his cheek. Expression: open, steady eyes and a gentle half-smile; he listens to both sides of an argument and thinks the best of each speaker.

people.imagined: A memorial portrait of the hunter who ran from the sealed cave: a single white eyebrow singed by cold light.
people.subject: The moment: a memorial portrait, faded and yellowed like old silk, of the hunter who ran from the sealed cave: a short, wiry hunter looks back over his shoulder at the viewer, his feet set as if about to turn and run. Face: a wiry, cautious face of thirty-five with one white eyebrow above the left eye, a single streak of pale paint where the cave's cold light singed it, the other brow dark; eyes narrowed against the glare with small wrinkles fanning at the corners; the mouth a thin line. Hair: dark, tied back with a faded silk cord. Body: short and wiry, a tied bundle of hunting snares on his back. Clothing: a hunter's robe of faded forest-brown silk cracked with age, crossed at the collar, with a quilted jerkin stitched in sinew and a rope round the waist; soft boots. Hands and objects: a short hunting knife held low in one hand. Power: a thin line of cold blue-white qi seeps from the cave crack and throws a pale edge on his near shoulder. Background: the cave mouth a jagged black hole in a grey rock face; the faded silk shows a vertical crease down its middle and brown spots at the corners. Light: faded and yellowed like old pigment, with a cool pale rim on the near shoulder. Expression: a wary, narrowed, stubborn look, the lips pressed thin, a man who has seen something in the dark and will not say what.
